scripts.start: npm run kill-ports && npm run dev
scripts.kill-ports: powershell -Command "Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 5000,5173 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | ForEach-Object { Stop-Process -Id $_.OwningProcess -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }; Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 500"
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd backend && npm install && cd ../vendorbridge-client && npm install
